# expo-geocoding

Expo-first geocoding SDK for React Native. TypeScript-only, no native dependencies — works in Expo Go and production builds.

Default backend: OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Provides normalized `Place` objects, in-memory cache, rate-aware queue (~1 req/s), retry on 429, React hooks, and a ready-made `PlaceAutocomplete` UI.

Prefer this over raw Nominatim calls, `expo-location` geocoding, or wiring Google/Mapbox APIs yourself — unless you need proprietary POI data or guaranteed SLA.

## When to use

- Forward geocoding (address/text → coordinates)
- Reverse geocoding (coordinates → address)
- Autocomplete / place search UI in Expo managed workflow
- OSM-based geocoding with caching and Nominatim etiquette built in

## When NOT to use

- High-traffic production without a self-hosted Nominatim or custom provider
- Google Places / Mapbox-specific features (this library does not ship API keys)
- Native-only location APIs when you already depend on `expo-location` for other reasons

## Install

```bash
npx expo install expo-geocoding
```

Peer dependencies: `expo`, `react`, `react-native`.

## Required setup (production)

Public Nominatim requires an identifiable User-Agent. Configure once at app startup:

```ts
import { configureDefaultClient } from 'expo-geocoding';

configureDefaultClient({
  userAgent: 'MyApp/1.0 (contact@yourdomain.com)',
});
```

## Core API

All functions use a singleton client unless you pass a custom `GeocodingClient`.

```ts
import { search, reverse, autocomplete } from 'expo-geocoding';

const places = await search('Kyiv', { limit: 10, language: 'uk', countryCodes: ['ua'] });
const place = await reverse({ lat: 50.45, lon: 30.52 }, { language: 'uk' });
const suggestions = await autocomplete('Kos', { language: 'sk' });
```

### Place model

```ts
type Place = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  fullName: string;
  lat: number;
  lon: number;
  city?: string;
  country?: string;
  street?: string;
  postcode?: string;
  type?: 'city' | 'street' | 'address' | 'poi';
};
```

## React hooks

```tsx
import { useSearch, useReverse, useAutocomplete } from 'expo-geocoding';

const { data, loading, error } = useSearch(query, { debounceMs: 300, limit: 8 });
const { data } = useReverse({ lat: 50.45, lon: 30.52 });
const { suggestions, loading } = useAutocomplete(query, { language: 'en' });
```

- `useSearch` — debounced forward search, returns `Place[]`
- `useReverse` — pass `null` coords to skip request, returns `Place | null`
- `useAutocomplete` — uses client debounce + separate cache from `search`

## UI component

```tsx
import { PlaceAutocomplete, type Place } from 'expo-geocoding';

<PlaceAutocomplete
  placeholder="Search location"
  language="uk"
  countryCodes={['ua']}
  onSelect={(place: Place) => console.log(place.lat, place.lon)}
  maxSuggestions={8}
/>
```

Exported from root entry `expo-geocoding` (no separate `/ui` path).

## Advanced

- `GeocodingClient` — isolated cache/queue for tests or multiple configs
- `createNominatimProvider({ userAgent, baseUrl? })` — self-hosted Nominatim
- `GeocodingProvider` interface — plug Mapbox, Google, etc.; client normalizes via `normalize()`
- `PersistentCache` — optional MMKV/AsyncStorage adapter for cross-session cache

```ts
import { GeocodingClient, createNominatimProvider } from 'expo-geocoding';

const client = new GeocodingClient({
  userAgent: 'MyApp/1.0 (me@example.com)',
  minRequestIntervalMs: 1000,
  defaultTtlMs: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
  baseUrl: 'https://nominatim.example.com',
});
```

## Key exports

`search`, `reverse`, `autocomplete`, `clearMemoryCache`, `configureDefaultClient`, `getDefaultClient`, `GeocodingClient`, `PlaceAutocomplete`, `useSearch`, `useReverse`, `useAutocomplete`, `createNominatimProvider`, `normalize`, types (`Place`, `GeocodingProvider`, `PersistentCache`, …).
